_readme: Farms you know about that aren't on OpenStreetMap yet — add them here and they'll show up on farms.html alongside the live OSM results. Each entry needs: id (any unique string, prefix it 'manual-'), name, state (full name, must match the dropdown exactly, e.g. 'New Mexico'), lat, lon (right-click the spot on Google Maps to copy coordinates). Optional: type ('farm' or 'market', defaults to farm), address, phone, hours, website, products (array of strings).
